_comment: Real call volume behind docs/_data/response_tokens.json (TRA-904, extended by TRA-945).
Source: one machine's ~/.trace/savings.json, re-read 2026-09-05 during TRA-945 —
20,359 recorded calls since the store was created, of which the 24 tools below
account for 19,792 (97.2%). The first twelve were TRA-880's set (88%); the next
twelve are the tail it left unmeasured. It is committed rather than read live
because the weighting of a published figure must be reproducible by anyone
checking it out, and nobody else's store has these numbers. Re-snapshot with:
and say in the same commit whose store it is and when it was read.
Counts include the bench's own calls (one per tool per run) — single digits.
This is ONE machine's usage mix, not the field. Never call it an average user.
